common_affordance: The rules contain only local pairwise inequality constraints over a fixed set of three colors, so the task is directly an ordinary graph 3-coloring problem.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It incorrectly reduces the problem to bipartite checking and therefore rejects valid graphs that require three colors, such as a triangle.
It explicitly checks only whether the graph is bipartite, using two colors and reserving color 3 only for uncolored vertices, so it cannot solve general 3-colorable graphs.

recommended_edit: Add a global requirement that all three auditing firms must be represented in the assignment, while retaining the existing pairwise-difference rule and examples. This invalidates the survivors' purely local 3-coloring outputs on instances where a valid coloring omits a firm.
